display.purpose: The single page headline. Capped at 16ch so it always breaks to three or four lines.

headline.purpose: The contact section's closing line. Capped at 20ch.

title-compact.purpose: Writing row titles. One step down from Title is how the system ranks a section without changing its structure.

body.purpose: The hero lede, capped at 52ch. Light weight at large size is what makes the first viewport read as prose.

label.purpose: Mono uppercase section labels; the hero eyebrow opens the tracking to 0.16em.

meta.purpose: Mono sentence-case metadata — the hero meta line and the footer.

shadows.name: marker-halo
shadows.purpose: The resting ring around a row marker. Spread-only, accent-colored: it makes an 8px dot legible, it does not lift it.

shadows.name: marker-halo-hover
shadows.purpose: The same ring widened on row hover. The only elevation change in the system.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: The only easing curve in the system. No custom cubic-beziers.

motion.name: duration-base
motion.purpose: Border, color, and box-shadow transitions on links, chips, and markers.

components.name: Content Row
components.description: The system's core unit, shared by projects and writing: teal marker, title, optional description, tag list, and a trailing arrow.
components.html: AssumioA private ledger of investment reasoning, not returns — track why you own each position and grade the thesis against reality over time.AstroTypeScriptAI-assisted
components.css: .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.1rem 1fr auto; gap: 22px; align-items: start; padding: 28px 0 28px 10px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(180,200,230,0.06); color: #e7eaef; text-decoration: none; font-family: 'Geist Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 0.2s ease; } .ds-row-marker { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 100px; background: #6fb3a6; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(111,179,166,0.1); margin: 9px 0 0 3px; transition: box-shadow 0.18s ease; } .ds-row-title { display: block; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.01em; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-row-desc { display: block; font-size: 14.5px; font-weight: 300; line-height: 1.6; color: #a2a9b4; max-width: 58ch; margin-bottom: 14px; } .ds-row-tags { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; } .ds-row-meta { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; color: #7f8792; margin-top: 6px; } .ds-row-meta svg { transition: color 0.18s ease, transform 0.18s ease; } .ds-row:hover { background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(180,200,230,0.03), transparent 70%); } .ds-row:hover .ds-row-marker { box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(111,179,166,0.16); } .ds-row:hover .ds-row-meta { color: #e7eaef; } .ds-row:hover .ds-row-meta svg { transform: translate(1px, -1px); } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #6fb3a6; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Tag
components.description: Non-interactive mono pill labeling a row's stack, source, or language.
components.css: .ds-tag { font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 11px; color: #7f8792; border: 1px solid rgba(180,200,230,0.06); padding: 3px 9px; border-radius: 100px; }

components.name: Contact Chip
components.description: Text-only mono pill linking to an external profile. Never carries a brand icon.
components.css: .ds-chip { font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 12.5px; color: #a2a9b4; border: 1px solid rgba(180,200,230,0.11); padding: 9px 16px; border-radius: 100px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 0.18s ease, color 0.18s ease; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: #6fb3a6; color: #e7eaef; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #6fb3a6; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Link
components.description: The hero's action affordance — underlined prose, not a button. The strongest call to action the system permits.
components.html: GitHub
components.css: .ds-action { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; font-family: 'Geist Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; color: #e7eaef; text-decoration: none; padding-bottom: 3px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(180,200,230,0.11); transition: border-color 0.18s ease; } .ds-action svg { color: #7f8792; transition: color 0.18s ease; } .ds-action:hover { border-color: #6fb3a6; } .ds-action:hover svg { color: #6fb3a6; } .ds-action:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #6fb3a6; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.description: Wordmark with a teal period, four lowercase mono links, hairline rule beneath. Wraps to two rows below 680px; no hamburger.

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 14px; padding: 30px 0 26px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(180,200,230,0.06); font-family: 'Geist Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-wordmark { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #e7eaef; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-wordmark-dot { color: #6fb3a6; } .ds-navlinks { display: flex; gap: 30px; } .ds-navlinks a { font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 12px; color: #a2a9b4; letter-spacing: 0.01em; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.15s ease; } .ds-navlinks a:hover { color: #e7eaef; } .ds-navlinks a:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #6fb3a6; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.description: Every section opens the same way: a mono uppercase label left, a mono note or data-derived count right.
components.css: .ds-sechead { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; padding-bottom: 26px; font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; } .ds-sechead-label { font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #7f8792; } .ds-sechead-meta { font-size: 12px; color: #7f8792; }

narrative.overview:
A dim, generous space built for one visitor at a time. Air is the primary material; the interface lowers its voice so the content can be read. The first viewport spends roughly 72% of its height on almost nothing — a mono eyebrow, a four-line headline, one paragraph in the owner's real voice, two underlined text links — because a visitor who is not on a deadline should feel invited to read rather than processed through a funnel.

The system earns credibility through calm. It is a single editorial column of ranked rows separated by hairlines, not a grid of cards; there are no panels, no filled buttons, no metric tiles, no logos, and no imagery. Every piece of chrome that a conventional portfolio would add — the hero card, the stat row, the "hire me" button — was considered and refused. What remains has to carry the weight, so the craft lives entirely in spacing, type scale, and restraint.

Two anti-references are confirmed and binding. The first is the neon-terminal developer default: GitHub's #0d1117 ground with a #58a6ff accent, which this system deliberately replaces with a cool slate charcoal and a muted teal. The second is the packed dashboard — density used as a proxy for substance. The palette is cool throughout, never warm-grey, and the accent appears only where it means something.
keyCharacteristics: Dark, cool, and content-light; air is the primary material
One editorial column of hairline-separated rows, ranked top to bottom
Exactly one accent hue, spent sparingly on markers and hover states
Geist for reading, Geist Mono for labeling — a hard division of labor
Fully static: no entrance animation, no scroll effects, no motion beyond hover
Real content only; nothing decorative stands in for something unbuilt

rules.name: The One Hue Rule
rules.body: Signal Teal is the only chromatic color in the system. There is no second accent, no semantic green/amber/red, no gradient between hues. If a new state needs distinguishing, reach for the text tiers or the hairlines first.

rules.name: The Cool-Only Rule
rules.body: Every neutral carries a blue-green cast — including the hairlines, which are rgba(180, 200, 230, …) rather than white at low alpha. A warm grey anywhere reads as a foreign body.

rules.name: The Contrast Floor Rule
rules.body: No text color falls below 4.5:1 on the ground, including the faintest metadata. Quietness comes from size, weight, and tracking — never from contrast that fails.

rules.name: The Mono-Never-Reads Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono is for labels, tags, counts, and metadata only. It never sets a sentence a visitor is meant to read. If a mono string runs past roughly four words, it belongs in Geist Sans.

rules.name: The Two-Tone Sentence Rule
rules.body: Both large headings split one sentence across Cool White and Cool Muted rather than splitting it into a heading plus a subheading. The system has no subheadings.

rules.name: The Measure Rule
rules.body: Every text block is capped in ch, not pixels — 16ch display, 20ch headline, 52ch lede, 58ch row description. Line length is a design decision, not a consequence of the container.

rules.name: The One Column Rule
rules.body: Content is never placed side by side. If two things compete for the same horizontal band, one of them is not important enough to be on the page.

rules.name: The Air-First Rule
rules.body: The first viewport commits roughly 72vh to the hero and never fills the remainder with a card, a metric strip, or a scroll cue. Emptiness above the fold is the argument.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow in this system draws a shadow. Spread-only rings in the accent color are permitted; blurred dark shadows are not. Depth comes from hairlines and text tiers.

rules.name: The No-Box Rule
rules.body: Content is never enclosed. No filled cards, no bordered panels, no background-tinted containers. A hairline above a row is the entire container vocabulary.

dos: Do spend Signal Teal sparingly — markers, the LED, the wordmark period, hover borders. If it appears more than a handful of times per viewport, it has stopped signalling.
Do separate with hairlines (hairline-quiet between rows and sections, hairline for interactive underlines and chip outlines).
Do cap every text block with a ch measure.
Do derive counts and indices from the data (String(items.length).padStart(2, '0')), never type them in.
Do keep the two mono treatments distinct: uppercase and widely tracked for labels, sentence case and lightly tracked for metadata.
Do reorganize at 680px — wrap, stack, and reflow — rather than scaling the desktop layout down.
Do verify at 375px that document.documentElement.scrollWidth equals clientWidth; this layout has produced overflow twice.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent hue, a semantic color set, or a warm neutral.
Don't use #0d1117 or #58a6ff, or any variation of the neon-terminal developer palette. It is a confirmed anti-reference.
Don't add blurred shadows, filled cards, bordered panels, or any mid-range corner radius. Structure is unrounded; small pills are 100px.
Don't add motion beyond hover — no entrance animation, no scroll-triggered reveals, no parallax, no marquee. The static quality is a committed decision, not an omission.
Don't set prose in Geist Mono, and don't set labels or tags in Geist Sans.
Don't add filled buttons or a "hire me" call to action. The hero's two underlined text links are the strongest affordance the system permits.
Don't add brand icons, logos, avatars, stock imagery, or illustration. The page has no images by design.
Don't invent metrics, testimonials, client logos, or years-of-experience claims to fill space. Cut the section instead.
